outcome: Mode of birth (normal vaginal birth, spontaneous vaginal birth, instrumental birth, cesarean section)
finding: Low-risk primiparous women who accessed a midwifery continuity model of care had significantly higher rates of normal vaginal birth and spontaneous vaginal birth, lower rates of instrumental birth, and fewer interventions during labor compared to those who received standard public care.
mod_finding: This study found that women receiving continuity midwifery care had increased rates of normal vaginal birth and spontaneous vaginal birth, and decreased rates of instrumental birth and cesarean sections.
